If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.5 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.5–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust downward by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.0 and forecast is above 70, cap forecast at 70.5 for early horizon to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is 0.0 and forecast is above 68, reduce by 1.0–1.5% for mid horizon to reflect lack of bullish momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is below 65, increase by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to avoid undershooting.
